title: About us
intro: The Department brings together researchers from several disciplines to study how knowledge is produced, shared and put to use. We combine rigorous inquiry with open collaboration across universities and institutions.
imageAlt: Researchers discussing a project around a table

missionVision.title: Mission and vision
missionVision.intro: Our mission and vision set the direction of everything we do.

items.title: Mission
items.text: Our mission is to carry out independent, high-quality research and to train the next generation of scholars.
points: Training for doctoral students and early-career scholars

items.title: Vision
items.text: Our vision is a research community that is open, inclusive and recognised for its lasting contribution to society.
points: An open and inclusive research community
Strong ties with partners at home and abroad

background.title: Background
paragraphs: The Department was founded as a small research group that met to discuss shared questions across disciplines. Over time it grew into a structured community with its own doctoral programme and research seminars.
Today it hosts several research groups and welcomes visiting scholars every year. Partnerships with universities abroad have made international collaboration a core part of its work.

regulations.title: Regulations
regulations.description: The regulations document explains how the Department is organised, how decisions are made and what rules apply to members and visitors. It also covers the use of shared facilities and the procedures for research projects.

cta.title: Get in touch
cta.text: Do you have a question, an idea or a proposal? Write to us: we are always glad to hear from researchers and institutions who want to collaborate.
